name: Soul Gun
body:
While many gunslingers choose the conventional and hard to care for early firearms, the Soul Gun uses his spirit to channel blasts of pure energy at their enemies.

Alignment: Any

Hit Die: d8

Parent Classes: Kineticist and gunslinger.

Class Skills

The soul gun’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (Arcana) (Int), Knowledge (Planes) (Int), Knowledge (Religion) (Int), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Table: Soul Gun
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spirit Gun

2nd	+1	+0	+3	+3	Mark target +1	1d6

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the soul gun.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A soul gun is proficient with all simple weapons, the rapier, scimitar, shortsword, and sword cane. They are only proficient with light armor, light shields, and bucklers.

Spirit Gun (Su)

A soul gun receives a blast of energy they can manifest similar to that of a firearm. This blast is a 40 foot ranged attack, however attacks made up within 20 feet are resolved at touch AC instead of normal AC, and deals damage as appropriate to their energy specialization. It has a x2 critical hit range/multiplier, and feats which affect firearms also affect the soul gun.

Energy Specialization

When the soul gun receives this class ability they must choose a single energy type. Their spirit gun deals the damage type chosen based on their element. Once chosen this cannot be changed later. Unless Æther is chosen, the spirit gun is affected by spell resistance as normal.

Fire: fire damage
Water: cold damage
Earth: acid damage
Air: electrcity damage
Æther: bludgeoning damage
Mark Target (Ex)

As a standard action the soul gun can mark a target within 30 feet of them and within their line of sight for their next attack. If they make an attack against the target on their next turn they receive a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +7 at 20th level.

Speak with Spirits (Sp)

At 3rd level the soul gun is able to cast Speak with Dead, using their soul gun level as their caster level. This can be done once per day at 3rd level and increase the uses per day every 3 levels thereafter. At 9th level it can instead be cast as Speak with Soul by spending two uses.

Blast Technique

At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter the spirit gun learns a new method of altering and shaping their blast. Unless otherwise specified these techniques cannot be taken multiple times.

Split Blasts (Su): As a full-round action the soul gun can split their blasts, making twice as many attack rolls as they can potentially make on a full-round attack but only dealing half damage on their attacks. These additional attacks beyond their standard attacks cannot target the same individual.

Charging Blast (Su): The soul gun can spend a full round action in order to absorb spiritual power within themselves. For a number of rounds thereafter equal to 3 + the spirit gun’s Charisma modifier (if any) they deal an additional 2d6 points of damage with their spirit gun. This increases by 1d6 for every 3 levels they are past 4th level (to a maximum of 7d6 at 19th level).

Sentinel Shot (Ex): The soul gun increases the range of their spirit gun by 20 feet, and this also increases the range of their touch attack with their spirit gun by 20 feet (60 foot range, 40 foot touch attack range).

Spirit Storm (Su): The soul gun can spend a full-round action to create a 20 foot radius, and the range in which the radius can be centered out to is as per a spell’s Close range (25 feet plus 5 feet per 2 levels). Those within the radius must make a Reflex Save (DC 10 + 1/2 soul gun’s level + soul gun’s Charisma modifier) or take your spirit gun’s damage, or take half damage on a miss.

Exorcist’s Shot (Su): As a standard action the soul gun can fire a single shot from their spirit gun against an incorporeal enemy within their spirit gun’s touch AC range. On a successful hit, the damage is halved but deals untyped damage instead and the creature is treated as corporeal for the purpose of other attack rolls against it for a number of rounds equal to the soul gun’s Charisma modifier. If this is used against an incorporeal undead creature, this instead deals full damage.

Zig-Zag Blast (Su): If the soul gun spends a move action to aim their spirit gun at a foe, they can fire off two attacks at a -2 penalty to both attacks as a standard action. These attacks ignore cover (except for total cover and improved cover) and total their damage together for the purposes of DR or energy resistances. If the soul gun already possesses a feat such as clustered shot, they deal their spirit gun’s base damage (with no modifiers) again if both attack rolls hit – similar to the Rend ability.

Blast Maneuver (Ex): Soul guns with this technique are able to perform combat maneuvers using their spirit gun as if it were a weapon with the maneuver in question. This enables the following combat maneuvers to be performed with the spirit gun; trip, bull rush, disarm, dirty trick, and sunder. Making combat maneuvers in this way allows them to use their soul gun level for the combat maneuver in place of their base attack bonus (effectively treating themselves as having full base attack bonus), and allows them to use their Charisma as their ability score.

Spirit Away (Su)

At 5th level the soul gun adds their Charisma as a bonus to damage with their soul gun.

Absorb Energy (Ex)

At 7th level depending on the energy type chosen by the soul gun’s energy specialization, they receive energy resistance 10 to that energy type. If they would be hit by an attack which is completely negated by this they are healed 2d4 hit points. This becomes Energy Resistance 20 at 14th level. If Æther was chosen, they instead choose either DR 5/slashing or DR 5/piercing. At 14th level this DR becomes DR 15. In a similar manner to the energy resistance, if the DR would reduce the damage to 0 or below the soul gun heals 2d4 hit points.

Beam Compression (Ex)

At 10th level the soul gun can transform their spirit gun into a 60 ft. line attack, with those within the line needing to make a reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 soul gun level + charisma modifier) or take 10d6 points of damage using the energy type chosen from energy specialization. Passing this reflex save avoids taking damage completely, and using this ability is a full-round action.

Charge Energy (Ex)

At 11th level when the soul gun resists damage through either their energy resistance or DR, they can as an immediate action absorb energy into themselves. bathing the soul gun in a ghostly blue glow. While in this state they receive a +10 to their movement speed(s), a +2 insight bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, and all saving throws. This state lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus their Charisma modifier, and can be activated once per day.

Shotgun Blast (Ex)

At 13th level the soul gun can choose grant their spirit gun the scatter weapon property and deal damage as if they were one size category larger.

Pierce Defenses (Ex)

At 14th level the soul gun can hit an opponent hard enough with their spirit gun that it opens the opponent up to further punishment. Any time the soul gun make a single attack roll (either through the attack action, abilities which have them make a single attack as a standard action, or abilities which have them make a single attack as a full-round action) after dealing damage on a successful attack roll, the soul gun inflicts the target with a -2 penalty to all d20 checks, AC, and all saving throws. This penalty lasts a number of rounds equal to the soul gun’s Charisma modifier.

Overcome Weakness (Ex)

At 17th level the soul gun’s spirit gun bypasses any energy resistances, immunities, or DR which attempt to stop it, so long as that foe is within the touch AC range of the spirit gun. Although its type remains unchanged, for example it would allow the soul gun to deal fire damage to a fire elemental.

Fierce Energy (Ex)

At 19th level the soul gun’s naturally powerful energy protects them. If they received an energy resistance from absorb energy, this becomes energy immunity. If it was DR which was received, they instead receive DR 5/- on top of increasing their existing DR to DR 30/slashing or DR 30/piercing.

Gritty End (Ex)

At 20th level the soul gun’s spirit gun becomes a deadly weapon which causes ripples in both the physical and spiritual worlds. Its entire range is considered its ‘touch attack’, the critical threat becomes 19-20 with a multiplier of x4.

Lastly, on a critical hit with the spirit gun activates phantasmal killer as if cast by the soul gun with the DC for the saves equal to 10 + 1/2 soul gun level + Charisma modifier.
